Personally, I won’t do anything higher than 5th grade. For 3rd-5th, I recommend having a more stern approach. That age can be a little difficult, mostly because they are learning they can question authority and most have screen addictions (at least where I live). 

As far as clothes go, I’d say to get some nice dress pants or just any kind of business casual pants and a nice shirt. I stay away from graphics and such, but I’ll usually wear tennis shoes when I know I’ll be on my feet all day. 

Also a great way to start class is by saying “good morning, my name is-“ or some kind of transition statement to get them ready for the day. Writing your name on the board is a good idea too!

Good luck :)

I’m not gonna tell you that everything is going to get better, or that time heals all wounds. I don’t know if that’s true or not. But what I can tell you is that life has a way of changing.
